contracts.note: Cap hits and contracts are not shown or checked: the only source we have (OverTheCap, via nflverse) does not permit republishing its contract data on a website without OverTheCap's consent. Trades are judged on on-field value only.

label: Model suggestions based on on-field value only: they do not consider salary cap, contracts, scheme fit, medicals or whether a club would trade, unless shown.
